title: Fireworks
description: Fireworks over a castle on a lake. Click the sky to launch a shell. Every burst is a point light, so the castle, the hills and the smoke light up with it, and the lake reflects the whole scene through its ripples. Auto-exposure reacts the way your eyes would, so a big volley darkens the picture and it slowly brightens again after. The castle and pines are from Kenney's Castle Kit and Nature Kit (CC0).
line: Fireworks over a castle lake. Every burst lights up everything around it.
hint: click the sky to fire a shell · drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
